AI Trial to Test Faster Breast Cancer Detection

A major new trial is set to investigate whether artificial intelligence (AI) can accelerate the detection of breast cancer. The trial, described as the world's largest of its kind, aims to involve 700,000 women in Britain. Euronews reports that the trial will determine if AI can help detect breast cancer faster, while the Daily Mirror highlights its scale and participant numbers.
